description: Source code for OpenAI LLM service implementation with context aggregators, including classes for context aggregation, handling function calls, and image frames.

classes.name: OpenAIContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pair of OpenAI context aggregators for user and assistant messages, marked as deprecated.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: Implementation of OpenAI LLM service with context aggregation support.

classes.name: OpenAIUserContextAggregator
classes.description: OpenAI-specific user context aggregator, inherits from LLMUserContextAggregator.

classes.name: OpenAIAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: OpenAI-specific assistant context aggregator, handles function call progress, results, cancellations, and image frames.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator instance.

methods.name: assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator instance.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAILLMService with model and parameters.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates a pair of OpenAI-specific context aggregators for user and assistant messages.

methods.name: handle_function_call_in_progress
methods.description: Handles a function call in progress, adding it to the context.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles the result of a function call, updating context accordingly.

methods.name: handle_function_call_cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a function call, updating context.

methods.name: _update_function_call_result
methods.description: Updates the context message for a specific function call with the result or status.

methods.name: handle_user_image_frame
methods.description: Handles a user image frame, marking the function call as completed and adding the image to context.
